back_cover_blurb: AI can draft your test cases. Can you prove they are right?
Engineers spend their days on requirements, test cases, logs, FMEAs and reports. This book shows you how to hand the routine parts to Claude without losing traceability, rigour or confidentiality.

You will build ten real tools for one fictional product, the WLC-200 window-lift controller: from a requirements reviewer to a nightly validation assistant. Every tool was run for real, and every result was checked by code against an engineer's answers.
- What you may and may not send to an AI
- Requirements review and test case generation
- Test log analysis and Word reports
- A knowledge assistant that quotes its sources
